public_reference.role: Parameter-name/scale cross-reference and13 public NP3 samples. Files remain outside the repository.
public_reference.provenance_limit: These are public community samples, not files exported by a Nikon application during this session.

container.record_header: big-endian uint32 identifier followed by big-endian uint32 payload length
container.termination: uint32 zero identifier with no length field; no trailing bytes in observed files
container.unknown_records: Retain identifier, ordering and payload exactly; do not infer semantics.

version.position: First record, payload at file offset12

comment.encoding: UTF-8, NUL-terminated, padded to even byte length; other variants remain possible

tone_curve.limit: Full header semantics, interpolation and rendering precision remain unresolved.

flexible_records.scalar_record_layout: Two bytes: encoded value and scale byte; unknown/sentinel states remain distinct from ordinary numeric values.
flexible_records.unit_step_rule: Observed ordinary value=encoded-128; first five values encode1 in custom-tone-curve samples.

color_blender.prefix: Eight hue/chroma/brightness byte triples in red,orange,yellow,green,cyan,blue,purple,magenta order; subtract128
color_blender.suffix: Four retained bytes; semantics not established

color_grading.suffix: Scale/flag bytes retained and not interpreted beyond observed values
